hooks.command: jq -r '.name // empty' | { read -r NAME; [ -z "$NAME" ] && exit 1; WT="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/worktrees/$NAME"; BRANCH="worktree-$NAME"; (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git worktree add -b "$BRANCH" "$WT" >&2) || exit 1; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.env" ] && cp "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.env" "$WT/.env"; (cd "$WT" && npm install >&2); echo "$WT"; }
